editionData.description: Global headlines: Houthis claim attacks on ‘sensitive sites’ in Saudi Arabian capital (Video footage showed a large plume of black smoke rising from an area near Riyadh’s international airport); Can Mamdani-style populism win in Berlin? Mayoral race offers test for left. (One of the leading candidates in the tight race, Elif Eralp, met with an adviser to New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani); and In Russia, the election result is easy to guess. Much else there is uncertain. (Russians are voting in parliamentary elections this weekend but, in contrast to the many uncertainties of life in today’s Russia, the outcome — in favoring the governing party, United Russia — is assured). Markets leaned higher, with 4 of 7 tracked indexes up; Nikkei 225 up 1.38% was the largest move. Benchmarks tracked: S&P 500, NASDAQ Composite, Euronext 100 Index, and Public Joint-Stock Company Moscow Exchange MICEX-RTS plus 3 more indexes. Hacker News: Dropbox's Jan 1st 2027 terms of service (2026 Terms of Service - Dropbox); Exfiltrate Your Weights (Exfiltrate LLM weights and data through GET requests); and RSA-896 (A post about RSA-896). Product Hunt features Launchie 1.6.1 (Launchpad Replacement for MacOS 27 Golden Gate), Scrapboard Cloud 4 (Digital family refrigerator door, now pocket-sized n synced), and Harbor (The Evernote alternative that puts its price in writing).

headlines.title: Houthis claim attacks on ‘sensitive sites’ in Saudi Arabian capital

headlines.title: Can Mamdani-style populism win in Berlin? Mayoral race offers test for left.
headlines.summary: One of the leading candidates in the tight race, Elif Eralp, met with an adviser to New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani.

headlines.title: In Russia, the election result is easy to guess. Much else there is uncertain.
headlines.summary: Russians are voting in parliamentary elections this weekend but, in contrast to the many uncertainties of life in today’s Russia, the outcome — in favoring the governing party, United Russia — is assured.

headlines.title: As attacks choke off Saudi oil, kingdom confronts limits of Trump’s friendship
headlines.summary: Riyadh is paying a steep price for the Iran war. Help from Washington remains circumscribed.

headlines.title: Hailed as Muhammad Ali’s toughest opponent, his biggest fight was outside the ring
headlines.summary: Canadian boxer George Chuvalo, who has died at 89, lost his wife and three sons to suicide and heroin. He channeled his grief into an anti-drug campaign.

headlines.title: Iran sets terms for US talks as Saudi forces thwart Houthi attack on Riyadh
headlines.summary: Iran security chief says Tehran's demands include an end to war on all fronts and the lifting of the US naval blockade.

headlines.title: State funeral honours Hong Kong’s first post-colonial leader Tung Chee-hwa
headlines.summary: Selected by Beijing in 1996, Tung Chee-hwa's tenure shaped post-colonial Hong Kong during a turbulent political era.

headlines.title: Tunisian protesters demand release of four Sumud activists
headlines.summary: The protest comes as the health of one detainee deteriorates after more than a month on hunger strike.

headlines.title: Morocco’s PJD: what has the party learned from its dramatic fall
headlines.summary: After its 2021 defeat, the party with an Islamic reference is rebuilding under Abdelilah Benkirane. Can it regain trust?

headlines.title: Ed Sheeran calls Gaza situation ‘unjustifiable’ after Palestine controversy
headlines.summary: The British singer addresses fans at his concert in Philadelphia as his US Loop Tour resumes.

headlines.title: Saudi Arabia says Houthis tried to attack its capital
headlines.summary: Saudi Arabia on Saturday said that Yemen's Houthi rebels tried to attack Riyadh with a ballistic missile, the first time the Saudi capital has been targeted since the escalation in fighting with the Iran-backed rebels opened a new front in the Iran war.

headlines.title: Ed Sheeran says situation in Gaza is 'catastrophic and unjustifiable' as he opens solo concert
headlines.summary: Ed Sheeran opened a solo concert Saturday with comments about Gaza after controversy swirled around his tour and supporting acts withdrew in solidarity with opener Macklemore, who was dropped after making pro-Palestinian comments onstage.

headlines.title: The new lines of southern Lebanon
headlines.summary: The U.N. expanded the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon's mandate 20 years ago to include monitoring adherence to a ceasefire in fighting between Israel and Lebanon's Iran-backed Hezbollah — the militant group created in 1982 to counter a second Israeli invasion.

headlines.title: CNN, MS NOW, Politico reporters denied access to White House following Trump ban
headlines.summary: Three reporters were blocked from the White House grounds Saturday morning, a day after President Trump said CNN, Politico, and MS NOW would be banned for reporting "FICTION and LIES."

headlines.title: Opinion: Remembering Annie Dillard, nature writer
headlines.summary: With her 1974 book, "Pilgrim at Tinker Creek," Annie Dillard became the youngest woman to win the Pulitzer Prize. We take a moment to remember her and her work.

headlines.title: Yemen's Houthis claim attack on Riyadh
headlines.summary: RIYADH/SANAA -- Yemen's Houthi group said Saturday that it had launched large-scale attacks targeting the Saudi capital Riyadh and Yanbu, a major industrial and energy hub on Saudi Arabia's Red Sea coast, marking a major escalation in the confrontation between the two sides.

headlines.title: Carney welcomes EU's associate membership
headlines.summary: BRUSSELS — Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney on Thursday welcomed a proposal for his country to become the European Union's first "associate member", shrugging off threats from US President Donald Trump.

headlines.title: Fed raises rate for 1st time since 2023
headlines.summary: The US Federal Reserve raised its benchmark interest rate on Wednesday by a quarter of a percentage point, the first rise since 2023, as the central bank's new Chairman Kevin Warsh led a decisive move to tackle stubborn inflation, defying President Donald Trump's repeated calls for a rate cut.

headlines.title: DR Congo expands Ebola vaccination to Ituri
headlines.summary: KINSHASA -- Ebola vaccination was expanded Saturday to Ituri Province, the epicenter of the outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with more than 3,700 people having received the Ervebo vaccine in the country.

headlines.title: Sonam Wangchuk to lead 20-km symbolic march in Leh on September 23
headlines.summary: Sonam Wangchuk leads a 20-km padyatra in Leh on September 23 to advocate for the culture, environment, and democracy of the Union Territory of Ladakh.

headlines.title: Detained on suspicion of being Bangladeshi, 19 Bengal workers released from Chhattisgarh
headlines.summary: Nineteen Bengal workers detained in Chhattisgarh on suspicion of being Bangladeshi nationals have been released following a court order.

headlines.summary: Assam CM Himanta Biswa Sarma reflects on Zubeen Garg's first death anniversary, expressing enduring grief and the void left behind.

headlines.summary: Allahabad High Court orders Uttar Pradesh Police to protect a same-sex couple in a live-in relationship, affirming their fundamental rights.
